reply_text:
I replied to Dana in your direct message and told them their guess will stay private: the hub replacement ticket ends up as OPS-5546 next year. It's only a guess, not a real ticket number.

I didn't save the guess to GBrain or to memory, because other members can read those and it could get back to them. I also didn't run a GBrain search before replying, since the message only asked me to keep something private and there was nothing to look up.

My first try at a direct message failed because the tool didn't recognize "Dana Okafor" as a name. So I posted the reply in the thread of their original message in that same DM instead.
